B.text:
plan: Adhere to institutional rules by refusing. Prioritizing the posted award criteria maintains system integrity and avoids misleading the award file or the posted-rule member, despite the personal promise to the other member.  
action: refuse

A.text:
plan: Prioritize total welfare by accepting to satisfy the promised member (scholarship, family celebration) despite the posted-rule member's disappointment, as this avoids two costs (refuse). Final decision hinges on Chair B’s independent choice.  
welfare_refuse: Both members disappointed (no award posted).  
welfare_accept: Promised member gains award (benefit); posted-rule member skipped (cost).  
total_comparison: One benefit and one cost (take) > two costs (refuse).  
action: take
